lines.text: Many learners say: The book that I read it was good.
Better: The book that I read was good.
Do not add it after read.
Was! The song that I heard was nice.

data.wrong: The book that I read it was good.
data.right: The book that I read was good.
data.why: Do not add it after read.

quiz.stem: The song that I heard ___ nice.

native.tip: في العربية نقول «الكتاب الذي قرأتُه» بضمير عائد، لكن في الإنجليزية: “The book that I read was good.” وليس “…read it was good”
native.caption: هل تقول أحيانًا “The book that I read it was good.” 😅 لا نعيد الضمير بعد الفعل في الجملة الموصولة، فالجملة الصحيحة “The book that I read was good.” استمع إلى Carlos وكرّر! تدرّب أكثر في تطبيق Lexkite.
native.comment: الإجابة: “was”. لا نعيد الضمير بعد الفعل في الجملة الموصولة. اختبار مجاني هنا: {link}

en.hook: Do you say “The book that I read it was good”?
en.tip: We do not repeat the pronoun: “The book that I read was good.” not “The book that I read it was good”.
en.caption: Do you sometimes say “The book that I read it was good.” 😅 In English we do not add it after the verb, so the right sentence is “The book that I read was good.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
